text_block_list.text:
After our outing, as I walked Daiwa 
Scarlet back to her dorm—

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Phew. I really got to let my hair down 
today♪

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Didn't that make for a nice break for you 
too, Trainer? Well, hanging out with me is 
guaranteed to be fun anyway!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: ...We had fun, didn't we?

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: —Ghk.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
B-By the way, isn't it crazy? If you let 
your guard down, the sun goes down in no 
time.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
"...Come to think of it, staying out too 
late is a problem for an honor student... 
isn't it?"
choice_data_list: Let's just say it's part of training!
Is it really that big of a problem?
Is it really that big of a problem?

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
—Fufu, what's that supposed to mean? 
There's no way something like that would 
work.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Well, if you do some training from here on 
out, maybe that'll become a proper excuse, 
huh?

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
...I was saying that as a joke, but now my 
body is actually itching to run...

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
...Alright! If that's the case, I'm on 
board with that idea! Time to get moving!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Of course, you're coming with me, right?

Afterward, Daiwa Scarlet tackled her 
training while having a wonderful time.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
I-It's a big problem! Because, between you 
and me— Well... how do I put this...

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
...Either way, it's a huge problem! It's 
about my everyday image!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Well, personally... um... I don't really 
see it as that big of a problem—

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
In the end, it's just a matter of how 
people around her perceive it...
choice_data_list:
Just say that you were dragged along by 
me.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
—Fufu, don't say something so stupid. That 
just makes you the bad guy, doesn't it?

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
I'd hate it if that ended up getting you 
taken off as my Trainer or something...

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
...Still, well. The fact that you cared 
about my image, um—

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Thanks.

Even after that, Daiwa Scarlet still 
looked somewhat pleased.
